text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Super Creek—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: —Oh. Fufu, that might actually be nice...♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Look over there~ There are so many Paka 
Petit plushes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Super Creek points, there's 
a claw machine filled with plushies styled 
after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, aren't they adorable? I feel like I 
want to take care of all of them~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I haven't really played these 
kinds of games much before...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Super Creek made a troubled expression.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really? In that case... I'll gladly 
take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Please do your best! Ah, but pushing 
yourself too hard is a big no-no!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
